reuse.why: Reuses getBudgetData for copyPreviousMonth and replaces three copied SQL queries with one selection helper; the goal_def check is written locally rather than shared with goal-template.ts, which has no exported predicate for it.

duplication.why: The skip rule is one predicate used by every month-wide action, and the three identical category queries collapse into getMonthWideCategories.

placement.why: The predicate and selection helper sit in server/budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use them, alongside getBudgetData.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, the query column they need and a release note change; single-category actions are untouched.

maintainability.why: A named, commented predicate (isSkippedByMonthWideAction) and one category selection make the rule easy to find and change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions go through isSkippedByMonthWideAction.

disguised_duplication.where: Duplicated queries are removed and shared, not reshaped.

one_place.where: isSkippedByMonthWideAction in server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth directly and by setZero/set3MonthAvg/set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg through getMonthWideCategories.
